strengths: Manifest: validates normalized unique inputs, declared script dependencies and bounded timeouts; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 8/10.
Plant/control declarations: enforce unique names and distinct red-versus-green requirements; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 8/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.
Expectation: requires exact integer exits and nonempty literal evidence predicates; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Regular-file lease: validates opened descriptors, associates bytes with permission modes and scopes handle lifetime; encapsulation 8/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 8/10.

Snapshot/fingerprint records: preserve content and modes, explicitly represent unreadable inputs and bind parsed manifest bytes to fingerprints; encapsulation 6/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Group-cleanup result: distinguishes verified absence of live members from remaining members or observation failures; encapsulation 7/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 8/10.

Step result: retains diagnostics and rejects timeout, truncation, capture, reaping and cleanup failures as successful evidence; encapsulation 6/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Variant result: publication requires the declared outcome, restoration and independently verified baseline, variant and restored checks; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Run report: publication requires complete ordered declaration coverage and current fingerprints independently of aggregate success; encapsulation 5/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 10/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

Output reservation: scopes checked handles, rejects filesystem identity aliases and tracks newly created destinations for refusal cleanup; encapsulation 8/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 9/10, invariant enforcement 9/10.

RunnerTests and embedded Control fixture: use the unittest lifecycle for isolated state, cleanup and explicit skip behavior; encapsulation 6/10, invariant expression 7/10, invariant usefulness 8/10, invariant enforcement 8/10.
